results.title: Pertaruhan 3: The Series
results.overview: Elzan has been framed. He must prove his innocence before his family suffers the consequences. The victims keep falling, and a secret from the past is uncovered. Who is truly behind all this chaos?

results.title: O Retorno da Macabra Biblioteca do Dr. Lucchetti
results.original_title: O Retorno da Macabra Biblioteca do Dr. Lucchetti
results.overview: Vonetta, Helen, and Clayton are back! Inspired by the work of Rubens Francisco Lucchetti, master of Brazilian comics and pulp fiction, these shadowy anti-heroes will have to face new challenges and even the devil himself.

results.title: Eleni.Kalimera
results.overview: Through the lens of social media, Elena shares her daily life struggles and her family’s challenges.

results.title: Dirty Hands
results.overview: Things are not the same for Ronan after a dispute with a customer in his restaurant.

results.title: Telaga Suriram
results.overview: In a remote village, a young girl named Suriram goes mysteriously missing. Maimon, who is deaf and mute, is the prime suspect in the case because she was last seen with Suriram. The village folks also believed that someone in the village was retrieving a mystical ancient ritual that involves children sacrifices.

results.title: Man Finds Tape
results.overview: Pulled in by a series of strange and unexplainable video clips, a brother and sister team up to investigate the events captured in the footage, only to discover a shocking secret that’s overtaking their small-town Texas community.

results.title: Plan F
results.overview: Franka is a punk—wild and loud—but her star is fading. Her younger sister Maya has retreated to their parents in the countryside and now lives somewhere between rubber boots, coffee on the sofa, and no desire for change. When Franka thinks she has seen their missing sister, Lilly, on the street one day, she feels compelled to at least try to “save” Maya. What follows is a chaotic road trip from Brandenburg to Berlin, a night full of arguments and laughter, old accusations, and new honesty. In the end, there is no solution, but maybe a new beginning. A raw snapshot of two women who are closer than they think.

results.title: The Wall of Sound
results.overview: In a large, empty gym, the protagonists Iris and Lea play hide-and-seek: time seems to stand still, while the approach of an airplane transforms reality in a mysterious and poetic way.

results.title: No Signal!
results.overview: It is about two young step-siblings spending the weekend with their parents in a lodge in a remote forest who accidentally film two bumbling criminals in the middle of a robbery.

results.title: Pink Sync
results.overview: As Lizzy spends her summer taking care of her depressed mother and working at their family campground in the Great Smoky Mountains, a mysterious comet crashes into the woods outside.

results.title: Red Harvest
results.overview: Scientists create Epsilon to control nature, but it awakens and fights back.

results.title: Bowls
results.overview: An argument over loading the dishwasher threatens to destroy a marriage.

results.title: François Baroin ou les hésitations du destin
results.original_title: François Baroin ou les hésitations du destin

results.title: The Christmas Cookbook
results.overview: Newly single at Christmas, Veronica Cearley finds unexpected comfort in The X-Mas Club — a festive group of food lovers who cook, give back, and celebrate the season solo. But when sparks fly with the club’s warm-hearted founder, Cullen Murdock, she realizes that the best part of Christmas might not be the food or the traditions—but the people who feel like home.

results.title: Gucci
results.overview: Gulcha, better known as Gucci, works as a cleaner at a community center in the Moscow region. She is in love with security guard Lekha, but he already has a girlfriend, accountant Lenka. One day, Gulcha argues with her colleague Masha that she can win back her lover.

results.title: Iluminaciones
results.overview: Five girls and boys periodically publish a cultural magazine, a kind of guide to the city's leisure activities. Each one is in charge of an area, from literature to cinema. And they live varied stories, both among themselves and with other people outside the group.

results.title: Cinco
results.overview: Ruby is a young man from a working-class neighborhood in Madrid, tired of the violence and distrust that define his group of friends’ daily lives. Together with Nélson, Daniela, and Alexis, he spends the eve of Saint John’s Night, where every plan and every action turn into a competition among the boys to validate their status within the group.
